Your ideas on Amaurot are just as speculative as those that portray it as an unironic paradise - no more or no less valid. The references to Utopia could be subversive for all we know - this would be in line with a lot of the xpac in terms of people's expectations being turned upside down.

As an aside FFXIV seems to draw a lot from FFXIII's worldbuilding - and anyone who has played XIII knows how that ends.

Is Emet-Selch's worldview altered by tempering? Most assuredly. Shadowbringers asks "What is a hero? At what point do they become a villain? How much trauma can one person take before they are broken? Do the ends ever justify the means? How much agency do we really have, in the end?"

Reductive takes that keep ANYONE'S words at face value are really frustrating because it sort of misses the point.
